title: Align recent-event form validation with command channels
changes: Accept Recent reads-on in the parameter form without optional ROM read-audit hooks, matching the shared console and local-control parser; warn that read observations are unavailable while other events remain collectable.
validation: Default Windows cross-build and Wine workbench, Recent and parser tests passed; audit-enabled Windows cross-build and focused Wine tests passed.
Wine/Xvfb EUR three-channel GUI proof used reads-on and on-error-off; identical settings and one explicitly unavailable-read frame per channel, followed by successful reports and three total frames.
Default-build typed action matrix compared Step, Inspect, Audio, Code, Gameplay, Recent and Graphics form defaults against console and CLI; invalid Recent event count was rejected.
limitations: GUI proof used simulated keyboard/mouse and an isolated EUR session under Wine; native Windows, physical input and full DBG2-13 operation parity are not covered.
A prior GUI attempt with on-error enabled froze Recent after a Windows control-reply access error; its failed diagnostics are retained and the follow-up proof used on-error off.
